theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Custom Forced Color Requirements
theme_and_archetype.description: Premium Executive Sales Leadership Network website mimicking HexaDash admin theme style. Clean white cards, generous spacing, subtle purple accents, and high-contrast professional look.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-tight
rules.alignment: Left-align dense content. Center-align hero and section headers if needed for symmetry.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 for container paddings. Sections should use py-20 to py-32 for breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.cards: Clean white cards (#FFFFFF) with rounded corners (12px to 18px / rounded-2xl), subtle border (#ECECF5), and soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm).
spacing_and_layout.grid: Use bento grid concepts. Mobile-first grid-cols-1, then md:grid-cols-2 or lg:grid-cols-3 for feature/profile cards.

animations.interactions: Card hover lift (-translate-y-2 + shadow-lg), button hover glow purple (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(130,49,211,0.5)]), fade-in on scroll (Framer Motion).
animations.parallax: Subtle parallax on hero graphics and abstract purple background elements.
animations.logos: Auto-scroll continuous marquee for trusted companies.

components.buttons: Primary buttons: bg-[#8231D3] text-white hover:bg-[#5F27CD] transition-all rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium. Secondary buttons: bg-white text-[#8231D3] border border-[#8231D3] hover:bg-[#EDE7FF].
components.navbar: Sticky fixed header, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90. Flex layout with logo, desktop links, and hamburger menu for mobile.
components.footer: Background #F4F5F7, py-16, grid layout for links (About, Membership, Events, Careers, Privacy, Contact, LinkedIn).

icons.usage: Use stroke width 1.5 for a premium look, colored in #8231D3 for accents.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use HTML-based React components (.jsx) combined with Tailwind CSS for layout. Do not use generic Shadcn components for major layout sections unless heavily customized.
Implement the EXACT colors defined in the theme (Main Purple: #8231D3, Deep Purple: #5F27CD, etc). Do not use generic tailwind classes like bg-blue-500.
The Hero section must have floating member cards and metrics, along with subtle Framer Motion parallax.
Platform Features Showcase should alternate left/right with text and mockup images.
Create a continuous logo marquee for the Trusted Companies section using framer-motion or CSS keyframes.
Hover states must be clearly visible: lift cards and add shadow-lg, buttons get a purple glow.
Make sure every interactive element (button, link, input) has a relevant 'data-testid'.
Cards MUST have white background (#FFFFFF), rounded corners (rounded-[12px] to rounded-[18px]), and subtle border (#ECECF5).
